'''James West''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Pontiac tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT flipping]], according to Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1676">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-pontiac-michigan-1-27-01d1676/ pontiac-michigan-1-27-01], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-pontiac-michigan-1-27-01d1676/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
